title: Enterprise Breach
description: A 3-hour team CTF covering Cryptography, Web Exploitation, and Network Reconnaissance. Format: 10 teams of 4 (40 participants max). Each team gets an isolated Linux desktop VM (Chrome, terminal, file manager) with access to the challenge network.
team_format: 4 members per team, 10 teams max (40 participants total)

challenges.title: Vintage Cipher
challenges.description: An old intercepted transmission was found in the archives. See crypto/README.md in this event folder for the ciphertext and how to reach the team VM. Decrypt it to recover the flag.

challenges.title: Hidden Admin Panel
challenges.description: A vulnerable internal portal is running at http://webapp:5000 inside the team VM's network. Find the flag hidden behind broken access control.

challenges.title: Port Scan Secret
challenges.description: Something is listening on the internal challenge network besides the web app. Scan it, connect to what you find, and read the flag it returns.
